name: Sarsi

ancestors.notes: Descent per Glottolog classification of Sarsi (sars1236).

notes: Research. Northern Athabaskan (Dene) language of Alberta, self-named Tsuutʼina, in its practical orthography. Lateral obstruents (tł, tł', ł=[ɬ]), affricate series and ejectives written with a following apostrophe, and gh=[ɣ] are mapped. Grapheme table checked against Cook (1984): no discrepancy found. STRESS EXEMPTION: Cook (1984) documents Tsuutʼina as a tone language (reported as a three-way H/M/L system in later work, e.g. Barreda) rather than a stress language in the sense this project's `stress` schema targets, and tone is not consistently marked in the practical orthography mapped here (as already noted); prominence in this language is a property of the tonal system, out of the `stress` schema's scope, so no `stress` block is added.
